newsitem.title: USA: Gap recalls girls denim jumpsuit.
newsitem.headline: Gap recalls girls denim jumpsuit.

text.p: Gap Inc issued a recall ON Wednesday for one style of girls denim snap front jumpsuit sold in its babyGap and GapKids stores.
In a statement, the retailer said about 5,500 of the jumpsuit have been sold.
The jumpsuits, made from 100 percent cotton, have snap closures which can separate from the fabric. The company said the jumpsuits are being recalled to prevent the possibility of accident or injury.
Gap said the jumpsuit can be returned to any Gap, GapKids or babyGap store where they will be exchanged for a $32 gift certificate.
The jumpers first appeared in stores on January 11.
